notes: Card: + pole peaks on 'el', 'gel', 'l', 'L' pieces in German/French text; the - pole is the same letter piece in English words (lice, lizards, lacerations). So the unit splits 'l' pieces by language. Probe: eingeladen 0.76, ausländischen 0.44, 'Lieber' 0.04, English 'Lizards' 0.03. Near misses are German sentences without such split words.
